senses.gloss:
r. 5th cl. (ञि-आ) ञिधृषा (धृष्णाति)
To be proud, to be confident or presumptuous.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (धर्षति धर्षयति)
To overcome, to overbear, to resist impatiently, to be impatient.
(उ) धृषु r. 1st cl. (धर्षति)
1 To collect.
2 To hurt or kill.
(ङ) धृषङ् r. 10th cl. (धर्षयते)
To neutralise, paralyse or make powerless.

m. (-षुः)
1 A clever man.
2 A proud one.
3 A heap.
E.
धृष to be confident, Uṇādi affix कु.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Impudent, confident, bold, shameless.
2 Forward, intrusive, presumptuous.
3 Secured, obtained.
4 Profligate, abandoned.
m. (-ष्टः)
A faithless husband.
f. (-ष्टा)
A disloyal or unchaste woman.
E.
धृष to be confident, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ष्णक्)
Confident, impudent, shameless.
E.
धृष to be confident, नजिङ् aff.

m. (-ष्णिः)
A ray of light.
E.
धृष to be arrogant, नि aff.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Confident, bold.
2 Impudent, shameless.
f. (-ष्णुः)
The branch of a bambu.
E.
धृष to be arrogant, affix क्नु.
